mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag_info (tag_name, tag_color) VALUES (#{tagName}, #{tagColor}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tag_color = VALUES(tag_color)
mapper.update: UPDATE tag_info SET tag_name = #{tagName}, tag_color = #{tagColor} WHERE sn = #{sn}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tag_info ORDER BY sn ASC

SELECT FROM tag_info ORDER BY sn ASC
LIMIT #{start},#{limit}

SELECT t.sn, t.tag_name, t.tag_color, COUNT(at.article_sn) AS art_size FROM tag_info t LEFT JOIN article_tag at ON at.tag_sn = t.sn GROUP BY t.sn, t.tag_name, t.tag_color ORDER BY art_size DESC, t.sn ASC
SELECT t.sn, t.tag_name, t.tag_color FROM tag_info t INNER JOIN article_tag at ON at.tag_sn = t.sn WHERE at.article_sn = #{articleSn} ORDER BY t.sn ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO article_tag (article_sn, tag_sn) VALUES (#{articleSn}, #{tagSn})
mapper.select: SELECT article_sn FROM article_tag WHERE tag_sn = #{tagSn}
